guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「導電感應、粒子軌跡與非鐵回收」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow induction, particle trajectories and non-ferrous recovery through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「非鐵目標與前處理」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 60 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「鐵件進入高速轉子區可能影響設備與分選。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「變動磁場與感應」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.2 V，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只看磁場強度而忽略變化率會漏掉感應來源。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「導電率與形狀」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0028 ohm，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用金屬名稱單獨預測拋射距離會忽略形狀。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「粒徑分級」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 4 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「一個分料板位置可能同時漏小粒又夾帶大粒。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「輸送速度與自然落點」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.319275 s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「沒有自然軌跡基準會把帶速差當電磁差。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「分料板位置」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.638551 m，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只看非鐵回收增加可能漏掉非金屬夾帶。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「單層料與碰撞」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 kg/m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「過量送料可能讓鋁片被其他物拖住。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「純度與回收率雙指標」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「高產品量可能主要是夾帶而非回收更多金屬。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「磨耗與間隙漂移」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.333333 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依轉速正常判定整機正常可能漏掉間隙變化。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「能耗與殘渣價值」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 7.5 kWh/tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「提高轉速若回收改善小，可能降低整體資源效益。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for non-ferrous targets and pretreatment, first reproduce 60 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ferrous pieces entering the rotor zone can disrupt sorting and equipment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for changing field and induction, first reproduce 0.2 V, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Field strength alone misses the role of flux-change rate." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for conductivity and shape, first reproduce 0.0028 ohm, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Metal name alone misses shape effects on throw." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for particle-size classification, first reproduce 4 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "One splitter position can miss fines while entraining coarse items." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for belt speed and gravity trajectory, first reproduce 0.319275 s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Without a baseline belt-speed effects look electromagnetic." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for splitter location, first reproduce 0.638551 m, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Higher non-ferrous recovery can hide nonmetal entrainment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for monolayer feeding and collisions, first reproduce 1 kg/m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Overfeeding can trap aluminium beneath other material." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for purity and recovery together, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "High product output may be entrainment rather than metal recovery." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for wear and gap drift, first reproduce 0.333333 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Normal rotor speed can conceal a changed gap." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for energy and residual value, first reproduce 7.5 kWh/tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Higher speed with little recovery gain can worsen resource performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 把鐵、鋁和塑膠分別標示輸送路徑。
比較磁通變化時間加倍後的感應量級。
比較薄片與團塊的等效迴路。
將寬粒級分成兩段再比較回收純度。
量測塑膠基準落點再加入鋁片。
逐步移動分料板並記錄兩個產品流質量。
固定轉子條件，減少送料量比較落點分布。
若產品總量60kg/h，另算純度並與回收率比較。
用固定標準樣件比較維護前後落點。
比較兩種轉速的電耗、純度與回收率。
evidenceEn: Trace steel, aluminium and plastic paths separately.
Double flux-change time and compare induced voltage.
Compare equivalent loops for flakes and compact pieces.
Split a broad size class and compare recovery purity.
Measure a plastic baseline landing point before adding aluminium.
Move the splitter incrementally and weigh both outputs.
Keep rotor conditions and reduce feed to compare landing distributions.
For60kg/h total product also calculate purity and compare recovery.
Compare energy, purity and recovery at two speeds.
pitfalls: 鐵件進入高速轉子區可能影響設備與分選。
只看磁場強度而忽略變化率會漏掉感應來源。
用金屬名稱單獨預測拋射距離會忽略形狀。
一個分料板位置可能同時漏小粒又夾帶大粒。
沒有自然軌跡基準會把帶速差當電磁差。
只看非鐵回收增加可能漏掉非金屬夾帶。
過量送料可能讓鋁片被其他物拖住。
高產品量可能主要是夾帶而非回收更多金屬。
只依轉速正常判定整機正常可能漏掉間隙變化。
提高轉速若回收改善小，可能降低整體資源效益。
pitfallsEn: Ferrous pieces entering the rotor zone can disrupt sorting and equipment.
Field strength alone misses the role of flux-change rate.
Metal name alone misses shape effects on throw.
One splitter position can miss fines while entraining coarse items.
Without a baseline belt-speed effects look electromagnetic.
Higher non-ferrous recovery can hide nonmetal entrainment.
Overfeeding can trap aluminium beneath other material.
High product output may be entrainment rather than metal recovery.
Normal rotor speed can conceal a changed gap.
Higher speed with little recovery gain can worsen resource performance.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 垃圾自動真空收集
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
